name: z-tool-finder
description: Progressive (lazy) loading for MCP tools in zcode: per-server proxy wrappers expose only get_tool_details/call_tool meta tools, a SessionStart hook auto-takes-over user/plugin stdio servers and injects an <available-custom-tools> manifest, and a global search_tools server indexes the catalog. Fully reversible via tf restore.

description_i18n.en: Progressive (lazy) loading for MCP tools in zcode: per-server proxy wrappers expose only get_tool_details/call_tool meta tools, a SessionStart hook auto-takes-over user/plugin stdio servers and injects an <available-custom-tools> manifest, and a global search_tools server indexes the catalog. Fully reversible via tf restore.
description_i18n.zh-CN: zcode 的 MCP 工具渐进式加载：per-server 代理 wrapper 只暴露 get_tool_details/call_tool 两个 meta 工具，SessionStart hook 自动接管用户级/插件级 stdio server 并注入 <available-custom-tools> 工具清单，全局 search_tools 检索 catalog。tf restore 一键还原。
